name: output-verification
description: Review structural gaps in caller-supplied claim evidence. No independent source verification; every verdict requires human review.

interface.shortDescription: Check claim evidence before human review
interface.longDescription: Checks caller-supplied evidence references and quote presence in agent output. It does not retrieve sources or establish factual truth. Every verdict requires human review before relay or action.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check these agent claims against the evidence excerpts I provide and show what a human still needs to review.
